summary: Notes that some tasks, such as `include`, `add_host`, and `debug`, always run on the control node and can't be delegated. Check the action's `connection` attribute: support `False` or `None` means it can't be delegated.
questions: Why does delegate_to have no effect on my debug task?
How do I know if a module supports delegate_to?

answer_card.title: Tasks that cannot be delegated
answer_card.answer_md: Some tasks always run on the control node and can't be delegated, including `include`, `add_host`, and `debug`. To check an action, look at its `connection` attribute in the docs: if `support` is `False` or `None`, it doesn't use a connection and can't be delegated.
